title: Trigonometric Equations and the General Solution
seo_title: Grade 11 Trigonometric Equations Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Determine the general solution and/or specific solutions of trigonometric equations.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 11 worksheets: trigonometric equations, solutions from 0° to 360° and the general solution. 100 questions with memos.
key_big: tan: + k·180°; sin and cos: + k·360°.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Make the ratio the subject: 2 sin x − 1 = 0 gives sin x = ½.
  • Find the reference angle, then use CAST to find the quadrants.
  • sin: x = α + k·360° or x = 180° − α + k·360°. cos: x = ±α + k·360°. tan: x = α + k·180°.
  • k ∈ ℤ (k is any integer).

Examples

Example

cos x = −½

reference angle 60°

quadrants 2 and 3

Answer: x = ±120° + k·360°

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
k·180°Only tan repeats every 180°.
One quadrantMost equations have two answers in [0°; 360°].
180° + xFor sin, use 180° − x.
